key_insight: A shared, domain-pretrained model forecasts distributed PV generation across sites and horizons, including previously unseen stations without local retraining.
engineering_relevance: Fleet-wide forecasting could reduce per-station model training and maintenance while supporting later adaptation to local operating needs.
method: Frame forecasting as sequence completion using historical PV power, weather observations, future NWP forecasts, and time encodings.
Pretrain across heterogeneous sites and forecasting horizons.
Compare forecast-aligned, generic, and mixed reconstruction objectives; mixed reconstruction provides the most balanced performance.
evidence_signal: Evaluation spans 479 PV stations—340 for development and 139 spatially held out for zero-shot testing—with reported gains over station-specific, shared, and generalist baselines across 6-hour to 7-day horizons.
watch_item: Deployment still requires validating NWP quality and transfer performance under weather and site conditions beyond the evaluated fleet.
paper_title: Foundation-Style Pretraining for Scalable and Transferable Distributed PV Forecasting
